results.exact_statement: For every integer base k >= 2 and every e >= 1, the bounded-depth totient k-kernel has rational dimension k^e + 1, with the explicit canonical basis indexed by the zero channel together with the residues r satisfying k does not divide r.

results.why_it_matters: Coons 2010 proves phi is not k-regular for any k >= 2, which is a qualitative negative. An EXACT finite-level rank with an explicit basis is a quantitative invariant of the same object, and it is what a specialist in k-regular sequences would want. The unconditional all-base independence proof is the whole gap.

results.exact_statement: For every integer r >= 1, Theta_r Theta_(r+2) < Theta_(r+1)^2 and Theta_r Theta_(r+2) - Theta_(r+1)^2 < 0. Lean proves r = 1,2,3,4 through an exact five-atom enclosure (splitting off d = 1,...,5, bounding the residual tail by (2^-r)^5/(1 - 2^-r) and discharging four exact rational inequalities) and proves every r >= 5 by a tail-contraction induction. results.exact_statement: Non-k-regularity of phi for every k >= 2 is Coons 2010 (J. Theor. Nombres Bordeaux 22, Theorem 3.2). It is STRICTLY STRONGER than any k = 2 corollary, and no Lean declaration in this package claims non-regularity. Do not present non-regularity as a result of this corpus; the exact rank k^e + 1 with its explicit basis is the addition.
